item.summary: fix(cli): stop approvals --json printing the exec-approvals socket token (#127610) approvals get --json and every local approvals write emitted file.socket.token in clear text, while the gateway RPC, the node-host RPC, and the state snapshot sanitizer all strip it, and the human-readable table shows only the socket path. The token is root key material: operator-approval-runtime-token.ts HMACs it to authorize local operator-approval clients, and agent-runtime-identity-token.ts reads it for the agent runtime identity token. Promote one canonical redactExecApprovals to src/infra/exec-approvals.ts, retire the two duplicate copies, and apply it to the local CLI JSON paths. It also drops the snapshot's raw field, which carried the same token as stored JSON.
